newsitem.title: CHINA: Diesel Engine B shares open flat.
newsitem.headline: Diesel Engine B shares open flat.

text.p: Shanghai Diesel Engine Co Ltd's B stock opened unchanged at $0.58 on Thursday despite the listing of an additional 85 million shares.
The new shares were sold earlier this month in a rights issue at a price of 3.36 yuan ($0.405) per share.
Traders said the stock stood firm despite dilution of the shares due to support from the underwriters of the rights issue who kept most of the shares in their own hands.
In addition, the company is expected to post much stronger results this year compared to last year mainly due to improved management and growth in China's national economy, brokers said.
Institutions were now more willing to hold the shares, they said.
"There might be slight falls in the next few days but room for falls will be very limited," said one broker.
Thirty minutes after trading started, the stock was unchanged on volume of 220,000 shares.

Following the rights issue, the company has 217 million B shares, accounting for 45.18 percent of its total 480.3 million outstanding shares. Domestic A shares account for 4.5 percent and the remaining 50.32 percent are owned by the state.
